info.name: Video converter
info.summary: Convert videos and extract audio within Nextcloud Files
info.description:
Convert video files and extract audio tracks directly from Nextcloud Files or via CLI (`occ video_converter:convert`).
* **Features:** * Convert videos to MP4 (H.264/AAC), WebM, MKV, MOV, M4V, and AVI * Extract audio tracks to MP3 or M4A * Supports VOB, AVI, MOV, MKV, WebM, MP4, M4V, MPEG-TS (.ts/.mts/.m2ts), MPG, FLV, WMV, and 3GP inputs * Configurable FFmpeg preset, codec, resolution scaling, bitrate, faststart streaming flag, and overwrite mode * Synchronous conversion or asynchronous background queue (`BackgroundJob`) to prevent HTTP timeouts on large videos * Direct Nextcloud virtual filesystem integration with automatic file scanner registration
* **Requirements:** * FFmpeg (`ffmpeg` binary available on the Nextcloud server)
